name: agents-eagle-eye-web
description: Build tooling for the Eagle Eye browser page (web/).

scripts.build:3d: cd web && bun build three/entry.ts --format=iife --target=browser --minify --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --outfile=eagle-eye-3d.js
scripts.build: bun run build:2d && bun run build:3d
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run check:bundle
